description: DTA Final Fortress balance and reviewed native placements.

perks.description: Increase the shared objective maximum health by 25%, 50% or 100%; it starts at full upgraded health.
One reserve squad per friendly house below 50% objective health, once per run. The objective receives Iron Curtain for DTA’s default duration. Later ranks improve the roster and veterancy.
Six ranks: +2,000 starting credits per rank, up to +12,000.
5% shorter production time per rank for infantry, vehicles/naval, aircraft, buildings and defenses; up to 25%.

Automatically deposit 1,000 credits per rank every 300 in-game seconds, up to 4,000 at rank 4. First payment after 5 minutes. Each human uses their own enabled rank; AI helpers share the host rank. No crates or collection.
Infantry, vehicles, ships and aircraft cost 5% less per rank, up to 25% at rank 5. Purchased separately from Cheaper Construction.
Buildings and defenses cost 5% less per rank, up to 25% at rank 5.
Raise positive native building limits by up to +3 without unlocking structures. Enabled DTA player power providers gain additional independently charging launch sites.

Eight ranks of mixed faction starting armies. Later ranks retain support infantry and add specialist armor, faction heroes, heavy aircraft and additional advanced roles, within the 15-unit staging area.
Rank 1: Veteran starting army. Rank 2: Elite, the highest veterancy. If Starting army is disabled, receive two faction infantry at the purchased veterancy instead.
Start with progressively more faction production buildings. Starting refineries include one faction harvester. Only the extra generators needed by the enabled starting structures are supplied.

Two emplacements per unlocked defense type. Faction limits: GDI 2 ranks, Nod and Soviet 3, Allies 4. Higher purchased ranks are retained for other factions. Only the additional power needed is supplied.
Six ranks: +10% defense damage, fire rate and range per rank, up to +60%.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Six ranks: +5% unit health, damage and fire rate per rank, up to +30%. Applies only to player/allied copies.
Unlock DTA’s Infantry Paradrop for every human player. AI helpers and enemies receive no randomizer power grants.

Unlock existing DTA player powers: GDI Ion Cannon and Airstrike, Nod Nuclear Strike, Allied Chrono Vortex or Soviet Nuclear Strike. Provider powers require their separate player building. AI uses normal construction.

Improve enabled human Fortress powers with existing DTA recharge, damage, radius, provider cost/construction and paradrop payload buffs where supported. Does not unlock powers; additional launch sites belong to Special Building Limit.
Increase power output from starting generators and all generators built during the run. Friendly helpers share the bonus. Each rank adds 25%, up to +150%.
Reveal the entire map immediately.
One normal allied skirmish AI per rank, up to two. Same faction and enabled perks as the player.
Unlock one additional faction special unit for production per rank. Allies unlock Tanya, Enforcer, then Battle Rig. Uses the ordinary faction war factory; unique-unit limits still apply.

Twelve ranks of mixed faction reinforcements every five minutes. Support infantry arrive from rank 1; later ranks add specialist armor, heavy aircraft and more advanced roles. Rank 7 is Veteran, rank 8 onward Elite, with a shared 150-unit living cap.
Eligible units and defenses heal automatically, including rookies. Existing stronger healing is preserved.
Increase eligible unit/defense sight and enable supported cloak sensors.
Raise positive live-unit limits on eligible heroes and unlocked special units. Does not unlock new types.

Unlock faction support technology: GDI Mobile Sensor Array; Nod Mobile Repair Vehicle and Stealth Generator; Allied Gap Generator; Soviet Shore Artillery. Requires radar and the normal faction war factory or construction yard. Native costs, power consumption and build limits remain. No starting grants.

Three ranks add +0.5 / +1 / +1.5 cells of weapon range and +1 / +2 / +3 ammunition to eligible friendly mobile units, using existing DTA buff limits. Finite-ammunition units gain ammo; Demolition Truck range and defensive buildings are excluded.

Add +15% / +30% / +45% health to friendly construction yards, factories, barracks, airfields, shipyards, refineries, generators and silos, including future construction. Objective durability is separate; defenses and support structures are excluded.

Add +1 / +2 / +3 passenger slots to catalogue-eligible APCs, Chinooks and landing craft. Gunner and sealed transports remain excluded. Does not unlock units, grant starting transports or add passengers.

capabilities.unsupported: Building-income upgrades, emergency objective repair and veteran defenses are excluded from DTA Final Fortress. Human powers and their upgrades use the existing DTA reward integration; AI receives no randomizer power grants and constructs ordinary native providers. Reserve shielding uses DTA’s configured Iron Curtain duration. Scripted air attacks use private native VTOL aircraft with unlimited ammunition; ordinary aircraft keep native docking and ammo. Countdown values use simulation seconds; co-op displays all friendly clocks together, with -1 marking completed deliveries. DTA uses native semipersistent death tags for small reusable delivery groups; untracked transformations and passenger-spawning wave units are excluded. Camp clearance and spacing follow each map’s reviewed layout.
